title: Rest-Api - Nightscout data download not working
symptom: With 'Also try to download data from Nightscout' activated, no data from Nightscout is downloaded. Users report that treatments are downloaded but BG data is not.
cause: xDrip cannot download BG readings from Nightscout; the capability does not exist.
fix: No fix; the feature is not implemented. Workaround: transfer database from old phone to new phone. A pull request was opened to rename the menu item to avoid confusion.
evidence_quote: xDrip cannot download BG readings from Nightscout. You will need to transfer database from the old phone to the new phone. I have opened a pull request to change the menu to avoid this confusion as suggested by Patrick. I am closing this issue as the capability does not exist.
